newsitem.title: USA: Judge refuses to halt Broward County, Fla., arena.
newsitem.headline: Judge refuses to halt Broward County, Fla., arena.

text.p: A Florida judge refused to halt construction of Broward County's new bond-financed hockey arena.
Tuesday's ruling by Circuit Judge George Brescher came in a lawsuit filed by the Allied Minority Contractors Association, which alleged the county violated competitive bidding rules.

The association said the county had illegally delegated its development authority to Arena Development Corp, a company affiliated with hockey team owner Wayne Huizenga's Florida Panthers Holdings Inc.
The judge tossed out the claim, allowing construction to proceed. The $185 million arena will have 19,542 seats and is scheduled to open in autumn 1998.
The county recently agreed that $96 million of the $116 million constructon budget qualified for minority bidding, giving minority-owned firms $28.8 million of the work.
